_note: Curated, cited evidence about which municipal plan and rules apply, and whether SmartPR's map layers reflect them. Each entry records what was checked, where, when, and what remains unresolved. Never a legal determination. Update only with new evidence; old entries are kept in git history.

rules.regulation: Reglamento Conjunto 2023 and subsequent amendments, as adopted by the Arroyo Plan de Ordenación Territorial
rules.evidence: Orden Ejecutiva OE-2025-039, reproduced in the Plan Final (p. 9): the first Plan de Ordenación Territorial of Arroyo adopts the Reglamento Conjunto para la Evaluación y Expedición de Permisos … (Reglamento Conjunto 2023) and its subsequent amendments for the related substantive and procedural provisions.
rules.unresolved: SmartPR's use rules encode the 2023 text; amendments after 2023 and any plan-specific provisions in the plan's Reglamentación section have not been checked against them.

evidence: Orden Ejecutiva OE-2025-039 (Plan Final p. 9): the Arroyo Plan Territorial includes minor modifications to the Classification Map of the PUT-PR-2015, under PUT-PR Chapter 4, Section B(4); the municipality also submitted a 'Modificación Menor al Plan de Uso de Terrenos de Puerto Rico'.
Plan Final p. 33: the final plan annex includes, where applicable, the 'Memorial Justificativo sobre Posible Modificación Menor al PUT-PR'.
Plan Final p. 40 (work plan): 'mapas propuestos y modificación menor al PUT-PR' presented to the Junta de Comunidad (Sept 2023 – Apr 2024).

layer_check.finding: Every feature in the island-wide PUT layer (PUT_v10) carries R_PUT = PUT-2014 and V_PUT = 30-nov-2015 (distinct-value query over all features). No feature references JP-PT-72-03 or 2025. The service publishes no edit date.

put.unresolved: Whether the 2025 minor modification changed the PUT classification of any given Arroyo parcel cannot be established from the PUT layer (it carries no 2025 version) — the plan's modification map / memorial must be compared to the parcel.

parcel_check.put_layer: SU 75.99% (34,757.9 m²), VIAL 24.01% (10,980.5 m²), AGUA 0.1 m² sliver; pin in SU
parcel_check.pt_calificacion_layer: R-I, clasificación SU over >99.9% of the parcel, resolución JP-PT-72-03, vigencia 01-JUL-2025
parcel_check.comparison: The 2025 PT layer classifies the whole parcel SU, while the 2015 PUT layer shows 24% VIAL. This is consistent with — but does not prove — a 2025 change; it may also be a difference in how road rights-of-way are drawn.

put.memorial_search: OCR of the Plan Final (pages read so far) finds the 'Memorial Justificativo sobre Posible Modificación Menor al PUT-PR' referenced as a separate annex (p. 33); the modification map itself was not found in the Plan Final. Request the memorial/annex from the JP or the Municipio.
